shared_elements: upright monolithic anthropomorphic form bearing low-relief carving
horizontal band of repeated elements crossing the upper part
paired/mirrored motifs symmetrically arranged at the top
small schematic creature-like figures in relief on the shaft
justification: Both show a tall upright block carved in shallow relief with a symmetrical pair of motifs at the top, a horizontal band of repeated units below them, and smaller figures scattered down the shaft, which gives a comparable vertical registering. But the actual content differs sharply: B depicts recognisable animals in profile (a quadruped, birds, elongated serpentine creatures) rendered naturalistically enough to identify, while A shows abstract curvilinear forms, a plain concentric ring and a lozenge-like sign with no identifiable fauna, so the correspondence is at the level of generic layout rather than shared motifs.
